documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Appointment of Statutory Auditor/s
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Sky Gold & Diamonds Limited reported a strong Q1 FY27 earnings performance, highlighted by consolidated revenue of INR2,013 crores and operating PAT crossing INR100 crores for the first time. Management emphasized strong traction in their Advance Gold model, international expansion with a new UK export pipeline, and a positive shift in operating cash flows. The company reiterated its long-term Vision 2030 targets and maintained its current revenue guidance for FY27 while indicating a potential revision post-Diwali. Sky Gold & Diamonds Limited reported strong financial growth for Q1 FY27, with revenue reaching Rs 2,012.8 crore and PAT touching Rs 104.9 crore, marking significant year-on-year increases. Management updated FY27 revenue guidance upwards to approximately Rs 8,100 crore, supported by increasing contributions from value-added products, diamond-studded jewellery, and the advance gold business.

guidance.claim: The company remains on track to achieve its aspiration of INR8,100 crores by FY27.
guidance.quote: We remain firmly on track to achieve our aspiration of INR8,100 crores by FY27 and INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores by FY30.

guidance.claim: Management stated they will analyze another quarter and revise their FY27 target after Diwali.
guidance.quote: So, we will revise our target after Diwali. We'll analyze one more quarter, and we will give our new guidance post Diwali. That's our plan.

guidance.claim: The company projects FY27 revenue at approximately Rs 8,100 crore.
Management expects EBITDA margins for FY27 to be in the range of 7.0% to 7.5%.
guidance.quote: • EBITDA margin expected in the range of ~7.0-7.5%

guidance.claim: PAT margin for FY27 is guided at 4.5% to 4.75%.
By FY30, revenue is expected to be around Rs 18,000 to 19,000 crore.
The company is targeting a sustainable revenue CAGR of 30% to 35% and projecting a PAT of INR945 crores by 2030.
guidance.quote: Target growth metrics. We are targeting a sustainable revenue CAGR of 30% to 35%, projecting a PAT of INR945 crores by 2030.

guidance.claim: Management stated they would like to avoid volume guidance primarily because of the volatility in gold prices.
guidance.quote: I want to make a small change to the guidance we have provided in the past. We would like to stick to our PAT guidance by FY30, but we would like to avoid volume guidance primarily because of the volatility in the gold price, which is beyond our control.

guidance.claim: Management guided for a conservative 5.25% PAT margin by FY2030.
guidance.quote: While these levers offer strong upside, we have guided for a conservative 5.25% PAT margin by FY2030, which represents an expansion of 75 basis points from current levels.

demand_outlook.claim: The company achieved 17% sales on the Advance Gold model, which is significantly ahead of the 15% expectation for FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: I am pleased to share that we have achieved 17% sales on the Advance Gold model, significantly ahead of our expectation of 15% of the Advance Gold model for FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Natural diamonds currently contribute approximately 2% of the overall business.
demand_outlook.quote: Further, natural diamonds currently contribute approximately 2% of our overall business, presenting significant headroom for future growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Participation in the Asiana UK India Jewellery Expo resulted in a prospective order pipeline of approximately INR30 crores to INR45 crores across UK and European markets.
demand_outlook.quote: The response was highly encouraging, resulting in strong initial interest and helping us to build a prospective order pipeline of approximately INR30 crores to INR45 crores across the U.K. and European markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Large corporate pool owners reported that it is very early to predict in one week and are analyzing June and July for consumer behavior.
demand_outlook.quote: And again, by talking to our large customers, large corporate pool and the owners with them I'm talking to, they are also telling it is very early to predict in 1 week. So they are analyzing June month, July month, how the consumer behavior is going to happen.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that gold exchange at the retail level has gone up from 20% to above 40%.
demand_outlook.quote: Many schemes are rolled out. We have heard that at the retail level, the gold exchange has gone up from 20% to 40% above. The regular rate is 20% gold exchange business, it has gone to 40%.

capex_expansion.claim: Current capacity utilization is around 55% to 57%, which is sufficient until 2028.
capex_expansion.quote: Currently, the capacity utilization is close to 55%- 57%. And looking at the current projection numbers, we are good till 2028.

capex_expansion.claim: Post-2028, the company may look at a new facility on a leased model requiring a capex of INR80 crores to INR100 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: And post that, we may look at a new facility, but that we will continue on the leased model, and capex will not be very big. It will be close to INR80 crores to INR100 crores, which will be just 20% to 25% of the PAT that we will generate at that point of time, since we have already built a world-class facility and we have already invested in the capacity and infrastructure.

capex_expansion.claim: Manufacturing footprint is expanded to 1,35,000 sq. ft.
capex_expansion.quote: • Manufacturing footprint expanded to 1,35,000 sq. ft.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expects to monetize land by August or September end.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, we have appointed 2 - 3 agencies also. We are expecting it by August end. I think August or September last, we will encash it. And so we have appointed 2 - 3 agencies for the same purpose also.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated gross margin increased to 9.3% in Q1 FY27 compared to 9.1% in Q4 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Our consolidated gross margin increased to 9.3% in Q1 FY27 versus 9.1% in Q4 FY26, an improvement of 27 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA increased to INR157 crores, reaching 7.8% for the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased to INR157 crores, to 7.8% for the quarter.

margins_costs.claim: The share of non-22 KT jewelry increased from 10.5% in Q4 FY26 to 14% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: First, the share of non-22 KT jewelry has increased from 10.5%in Q4FY26 to 14% in Q1 FY27 due to structural shift in customer preference towards lower Karatage jewelry.

margins_costs.claim: The share of studded jewelry increased from 1.65% in Q4 FY26 to 2.1% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: The share of studded jewelry has also increased from 1.65% in Q4 '26 to 2.1% in Q1 '27, on account of management's focus on better-margin products.

margins_costs.claim: Value-Added share of business has surged from less than 10% in FY23 to 50-55% in FY26, serving as the primary driver for gross margin expansion.
margins_costs.quote: • Margin Expansion: Reflecting our strengthening merchandising capabilities, our Value-Added share of business has surged from <10% in FY23 to ~50-55% in FY26, serving as the primary driver for gross margin expansion.

margins_costs.claim: Gold loss was reduced from 1.5% to a lean 0.5% through the implementation of an ERP.
margins_costs.quote: • Operational Excellence: We have implemented an ERP to monitor operational KPI’s, this has led to reduction of gold loss from 1.5% to a lean 0.5%.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margins will guide for 10-20 bps improvement year-on-year as investments continue in new geographies and high-growth categories.
margins_costs.quote: However, we guide for 10-20 bps improvement in PAT margins Y-o-Y as we continue investing in new geographies and high-growth categories.

margins_costs.claim: The consolidated gross margin stands at 8.45%, up 245 basis points from 6% in FY24.
margins_costs.quote: From the current year-to-date, our consolidated gross margin stands at 8.45%, up 245 basis points from 6% in FY24.

margins_costs.claim: Interest expenses currently account for 1.25% of sales.
margins_costs.quote: Today, interest expenses account for 1.25% of sales, which is a significant drag.

margins_costs.claim: The FY26 PAT margin stands at 4.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Our FY26 PAT margin stands at 4.5%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's production capacity is 1.2 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: So, 1.2 tons is our capacity to produce, and we are 60% approx utilization in the last quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: The annualized exit run rate for Q4 of revenue was INR1,911 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: We would also provide another comfort to investors. Our annualized exit run rate for Q4 of INR1,911 crores is close to the guidance of INR8,100 crores provided for FY27, as we would not require substantial incremental working capital for growth.

orders_capacity.claim: In Q4, the company did around 650 kgs per month in volume.
orders_capacity.quote: Siddharth Sipani: We would like to just inform that in the last Q4, we have done around 650 kgs per month, and that is in line with our guidance that we have provided.

orders_capacity.claim: The total processing capacity is 1.2 tons, with utilization at 55% as of the last quarter exit.
orders_capacity.quote: So again, 1.2-ton capacity we have, we are 650 kg last quarter exit. So, we have a 55% utilization.

capital_allocation.claim: The company generated approximately INR30 crores of operating cash flow during the quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: I am pleased to report that during quarter, the company has generated approximately INR30 crores of operating cash flow, marking an important milestone in our journey towards building a stronger and more self- sufficient business model.

capital_allocation.claim: Beginning in FY27, the company will adopt a zero-salary promoter compensation model linked entirely to dividends declared from operating cash flows.
capital_allocation.quote: Beginning FY27, we will adopt a zero-salary promoter compensation model. Going forward, promoter remuneration will be linked entirely to dividends, and dividends will be declared only from operating cash flow generated by the business.

capital_allocation.claim: The net debt level for the quarter was INR540 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Net debt level for this quarter is INR540 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Promoters will not draw salaries from FY27 and all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.
capital_allocation.quote: In line with our cash-first philosophy and uncompromising governance standards, promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.

capital_allocation.claim: Net working capital days dropped from 71 days for the quarter ended March 25 to 59 days for the quarter ended March 26.
capital_allocation.quote: And our net working capital days have successfully dropped from 71 days for quarter ended March '25 to 59 days for this quarter ended March 26.

capital_allocation.claim: As of March end, GML outstanding is nil, but the company has INR170 crores of GML facility sanctioned.
capital_allocation.quote: And that is why as of March end, our GML outstanding is nil, but we have INR170 crores of GML facility sanctioned with us.

risks_headwinds.claim: Heightened volatility in gold prices has created margin pressures across retailers and manufacturers within the jewelry industry.
risks_headwinds.quote: In recent quarters, heightened volatility in gold prices has created margin pressures across various retailers and manufacturers within the jewelry industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the wider sector is experiencing a temporary phase of demand softness resulting from tightening conditions and government appeals regarding gold imports.
risks_headwinds.quote: While the wider sector is experiencing a temporary phase of demand softness as a result of this tightening conditions, Sky Gold business model is explicitly built to thrive in such an environment.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to reach an Advance Gold business share of 20% next year and 25% in the third year.
management_commitments.quote: We have achieved 18% Advance Gold business, and we have given him the target for this year to be average of 15%, next year 20%, and the third year of 25%.

management_commitments.claim: By 2030, the company aims to achieve 30% of the Advance Gold business.
management_commitments.quote: In 2030, we will achieve 30% of the Advance Gold business, which we have given him set the target.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets reaching 52 working capital days by 2030 under the Sky Gold Vision 2030.
management_commitments.quote: with an overall target to reach 52 days by 2030 in the Sky Gold Vision 2030 that we are looking at.

management_commitments.claim: Promoters will not draw salaries starting from FY27, and all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.
management_commitments.quote: In line with our cash-first philosophy and uncompromising governance standards, promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.

management_commitments.claim: By FY30, advance gold is expected to contribute approximately 30% of volumes.
management_commitments.quote: By FY30, advance gold is expected to contribute ~30% of volumes, is 11.5% in FY26.

management_commitments.claim: The company projects FY27 revenue at approximately Rs 8,100 crore.
Revenue by FY30 is expected to be around Rs 18,000 to 19,000 crore.
Growth will be funded strictly through internal cash generation to achieve a net debt-free balance sheet by FY30.
management_commitments.quote: Growth will be funded strictly through internal cash generation to achieve a net debt-free balance sheet by FY30.

management_commitments.claim: There would be a debt reduction of over 50% in FY27 itself through land sale and operational improvement.
management_commitments.quote: I repeat there would be a debt reduction of over 50% in FY27 itself. A larger portion of debt reduction would be due to operational reasons.

management_commitments.claim: Management is advancing towards the FY30 target of achieving sales of INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores with a nil net debt position.
management_commitments.quote: This strategic appointment reinforces our commitment to professionalizing management, enforcing strong governance and positioning the company for accelerated growth as we advance towards our FY30 target of achieving sales of INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores with a nil net debt position.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
